description.value: Old-world sensor grids still half-work, and half-working is a gap you can walk through. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to avoid detection by non-living sensors, cameras, or constructs specifically, as opposed to living creatures.

cinderfall.incomplete: The +2 bonus is meant to apply against 'non-living sensors, cameras, or constructs' -- constructs could use target:trait:construct, but sensors and cameras are not actors with traits in this corpus, so the predicate can't cover the full stated scope without inventing a mechanism.
